title: Phishing link
summary: A message sends you to a sign-in, payment, or document link you did not expect.
scenario: The link uses urgency or familiar branding to collect credentials or payment details.
safe_actions: Do not open the link again
Open the service using a known bookmark or app
Never enter credentials after following an unexpected message
recovery_guidance: Change credentials from a trusted route if entered
Contact the provider and monitor activity
reporting_guidance: Preserve the message and visible destination
prevention_tips: Navigate independently rather than trusting links
Use password-manager domain matching as a prompt to verify
false_positive_notes: Some real services send links, but you can still use a known route instead.
